lines.text: The Israelites ask Gideon to rule over them, but he says the LORD shall rule over them.
Each man gives Gideon a gold earring from his plunder, and the earrings weigh 1,700 shekels.
Gideon makes an ephod from the gold and places it in Shiloh, and Israel worships it there.
The land has rest for forty years, and Gideon has seventy sons, plus Abimelech, born to his concubine in Bethel.
After Gideon dies at a ripe old age, the Israelites turn to the Baals and forget the LORD.
